crossRefs.note: “Why will you contend with me? You all have transgressed against me,” says Yahweh.
“Yet you said, ‘I am innocent. Surely his anger has turned away from me.’ “Behold, I will judge you, because you say…
Yahweh stands up to contend, and stands to judge the peoples.
Put me in remembrance. Let us plead together. Declare your case, that you may be justified.
I will bring you into the wilderness of the peoples, and there I will enter into judgment with you face to face.
Just as I entered into judgment with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so I will enter into judgment…
Contend with your mother! Contend, for she is not my wife, neither am I her husband; and let her put away her…
Hear, you mountains, Yahweh’s controversy, and you enduring foundations of the earth; for Yahweh has a controversy with…
you shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them, for I, Yahweh your God, am a jealous God, visiting the…
then I will set my face against that man and against his family, and will cut him off, and all who play the prostitute…

translations.web: “Therefore I will yet contend with you,” says Yahweh, “and I will contend with your children’s children.
translations.bsb: Therefore, I will contend with you again, declares the LORD, and I will bring a case against your children’s children.
translations.kjv: Wherefore I will yet plead with you, saith the LORD, and with your children's children will I plead.
translations.asv: Wherefore I will yet contend with you, saith Jehovah, and with your children's children will I contend.
